bm25.query: row query only; the instruction is not concatenated
bm25.document: name, description, and parameter names via parse_tool and render_tool

candidate_policy: The plan does not say to keep a positive BM25 missed. Every unique positive is kept, and the remaining slots up to 50 are filled from the BM25 ranking. Lowest non-positives are dropped to stay at 50. A positive that still does not fit counts as a miss.
